Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents a single expense or income record.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns the transaction.

amount.description: Amount of money in the transaction.

type.description: Type of transaction, EXPENSE or INCOME.

note.description: Optional notes or details for the transaction.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format for fast querying and filtering.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the transaction was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the transaction was last updated.

BudgetGoal.title: BudgetGoal
BudgetGoal.description: User budget settings, daily and monthly spending limits.

monthlyBudget.description: Maximum target budget for the month.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when budget settings were created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when budget settings were last updated.

/users/{userId}/budget/{budgetId}.description: User's monthly and daily budget settings.
